original.preservedAt: preregistration-amendment.md, which reproduces the original identity and states what changed and why

governedAcquisitionOcrUnderOriginalPrere.evidence: No raw/ directory, no raw-evidence manifest and no execution workflow ever existed on this branch. The original Stage 1 commit added planning artifacts only, and CI on that commit ran no acquisition.

reasonForAmendment: PR #220 merged, supplying complete default-off filter diagnostics, which resolves the original first-reason-only limitation.
The original acquisition input exposed historical case IDs and fixture paths; opaque item IDs and generic staged filenames replace them.
The original pre-freeze scan compared emitted evidence against governed Brand strings, which would misread a legitimate OCR transcript as leakage; truth-string comparison moves to post-freeze.
Candidate identity was a truncated digest; it becomes an ordinal plus a full 64-character digest with collision and count assertions.
A repository-footprint gate was needed for the raw evidence.
